title: Voice doctor visit (phoniatrist)
what: This is an ENT doctor who treats voice problems. They listen to how you speak and check your vocal cords with a mirror or a thin camera.
why: For hoarseness lasting more than 2 to 3 weeks, a voice that tires quickly, and for teachers, singers, and anyone who talks a lot.
duration: usually 20 to 40 minutes; the doctor tells you the findings during the visit
tell_doctor: How long your voice has been different and what came before it
How much you talk or sing during the day
If you have heartburn or sour burps
If you had surgery on your neck or thyroid

prepare.title: Voice
prepare.text: Before the visit, do not shout or strain your voice.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: If a camera will be used, it is better not to eat a big meal 1 to 2 hours before.

prepare.title: Recordings
prepare.text: If your voice changes during the day, you can record it on your phone and show the doctor.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: The doctor asks about your voice and your work
You are asked to say a few phrases or hold a sound
The doctor checks your throat and voice box
Sometimes a thin camera is put in your mouth or nose, and you are asked to say "eee"
The screen shows how your vocal cords close
The doctor explains what they saw and gives advice
feel: Checking the voice box may make you gag
Before the camera, a numbing spray is sometimes used, and your throat goes numb
after: If a numbing spray was used, do not eat or drink for about an hour
The doctor may prescribe voice rest or sessions with a voice therapist
Sometimes a repeat exam is needed after a few weeks
red_flags: It becomes hard to breathe or swallow: call emergency services
Hoarseness that lasts more than 2 to 3 weeks

faq.q: Should I stay silent if I lose my voice?
faq.a: Usually you are advised to talk less and not whisper, because whispering also strains the vocal cords. The doctor will tell you exactly what to do.

faq.q: How is a voice doctor different from a regular ENT?
faq.a: A voice doctor knows more about the voice: how the vocal cords work and how to restore them.

reminders.text: Voice doctor visit tomorrow. Rest your voice today and do not shout.
